newsitem.title: UK: Daimler's Schrempp expects to hit profit goal.
newsitem.headline: Daimler's Schrempp expects to hit profit goal.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG Chairman Juergen Schrempp said on Thursday he expected the group would achieve its 12 percent return on capital employed goal within two years.

Speaking at a news conference where the company presented half-year results for 1997, Schrempp said, "The return on capital employed is on target. We want to hit 12 percent (for the group) in two years and this looks very, very achievable."
He also said productivity agreements with labour unions had helped the company achieve its profit goals.
Schrempp, who has led a campaign to make Daimler more profitable, has laid down strict profit goals where individual operating units must achieve a return on capital employed of 12 percent.
